descriptions.default: Only trusted commands (ls, cat, grep, git status, etc.) run automatically. Other commands are skipped. Can write to workspace.
descriptions.auto: A model classifier decides per tool call whether to approve or deny. Hands-off, but safer than Bypass — denials still happen.
descriptions.acceptEdits: All commands run automatically within the workspace. Full auto mode with sandboxed execution.
descriptions.bypassPermissions: Full system access with no restrictions. All commands run automatically with full disk and network access. Use with caution.
descriptions.plan: Planning mode - no commands are executed

default.label: Ask
default.description: Reads files in the project folder on its own. Asks before editing files, running commands, going online or reading outside the folder.

acceptEdits.label: Edit automatically
acceptEdits.description: Edits and creates files in the project folder on its own. Commands and anything outside the folder still need your approval.

plan.label: Plan first
plan.description: Changes nothing: explores and proposes a plan for you to approve.

auto.label: Auto
auto.description: Acts on its own; a second model reviews risky steps and still asks about them.

bypassPermissions.label: Bypass permissions
bypassPermissions.description: Does everything without asking, including outside the folder. Only for tasks you fully trust.
